# Novels Haven

> > Novels Haven is a web novel translation platform specializing in Asian light novels, particularly xianxia and romance genres with cultivation and galgame elements.

The platform features ongoing serialized translations of novels like 'The Galgame Martial Saint' and 'Mind-Controlled by the Villainess? I'll Turn the Tables and Make Her Mine!' with active community engagement through Discord. Novels Haven also recruits translators and publishes platform news and terminology updates.

## Key Topics

- The Galgame Martial Saint
- Web novel translations
- Xianxia cultivation
- Galgame mechanics
- Asian light novels
- Dao Throne terminology
- Novel Updates integration
- Discord community
- Translator recruitment
- Volume serialization
- Character relationships (Ansu, Celia, Yu Wenqiu, Gu Chengming)
- Romance and harem genres
- Mind control themes
- Cultivation systems

- [The Galgame Martial Saint](https://novelshaven.com/series/the-galgame-martial-saint): Xianxia harem series main page: galgame cultivation with Yu Wenqiu
